correctness.rationale: Simultaneous orthonormal diagonalization of Sigma and L reduces to stable scalar OU driven oscillators. Exact stationarity equations yield E[vf]=s tau/(mDlambda), Var(v)=T/m+s tau/(m² gamma Dlambda) and Var(q)=[T/m+(1+gamma tau)s tau/(m² gamma Dlambda)]/lambda for lambda>0. Flat Gaussian velocity variance iff Sigma=cD; translation position excluded. Equal-time y-v covariance vanishes, giving a two-temperature Gibbs product; per-site active power c tau/m remains positive. On a ring, D=aI-b(S+S^T), a>2b>0, so inverse has all strictly positive entries by graph-walk expansion and AG=(aG-I)/b. Off-diagonal signs are exactly those of 1+a epsilon/b, including n=3. Independently solved seven full stationary Lyapunov systems (path and rings) and checked covariance and sign changes; numerical samples are not the global proof.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks corroborate only their stated bounded domain; the universal claim depends on reconstructed analytic proof.
